# War Scroll Column 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** complete

---

**13:1** For to-You belongs the-battle, and-by the-strength of-Your-hand their-corpses are-scattered without-one-to-bury. Goliath

**13:2** the-Gittite, a-mighty-man of-valor, You-delivered into-the-hand of-David Your-servant, for in-the-name of

**13:3** Your-great-holiness he-trusted, and-not in-sword and-spear. For the-battle is Yours. He-subdued

**13:4** the-Philistines many-times by-Your-holy-name. And-also by-the-hand of-our-kings You-saved us

**13:5** many-times, for-the-sake of-Your-covenant-faithfulness and-not according-to our-deeds which-we-did-wickedly, nor for-our-transgressions of-rebellion.

**13:6** For to-You belongs the-battle, and-from-You is-the-might, and-it is not ours. Neither our-strength nor-the-might

**13:7** of-our-hands has-done valiantly, but by-Your-strength and-by-the-might of-Your-great-valor. As You-told-us

**13:8** from-of-old, saying: A-star shall-step-forth from-Jacob, and-a-scepter shall-arise from-Israel. He-shall-crush the-temples

**13:9** of-Moab and-tear-down all the-sons of-Seth. And-he-shall-rule from-Jacob and-shall-destroy the-survivor from-the-city.

**13:10** And-the-enemy shall-be a-possession, and-Israel shall-do valiantly. Today is His-appointed-time to-subdue and-to-bring-low the-prince

**13:11** of-the-dominion of-wickedness. He-will-send eternal-aid to-the-lot He-has-redeemed by-the-power of-the-majestic

**13:12** angel, for-the-rule of-Michael in-eternal-light, to-illuminate with-joy the-covenant of-Israel, peace and-blessing

**13:13** for-the-lot of-God, to-exalt the-rule of-Michael among the-angels and-the-dominion of-Israel

**13:14** among-all flesh. And-righteousness shall-rejoice in-the-heights, and-all the-sons of-His-truth shall-be-glad

**13:15** in-eternal-knowledge. And-you, sons of-His-covenant, be-strong in-the-crucible of-God until He-waves

**13:16** His-hand and-fills His-crucibles with-His-mysteries, that-you-may-stand in-the-appointed-time of-

**13:17** His-visitation.

---

*EMET notes: Column 13 celebrates God's power over Belial through historical precedent and eschatological promise. Goliath narrative (13:1-5) serves as paradigm. Numbers 24:17 (Star Prophecy) quoted in 13:8-9, a key messianic proof-text at Qumran. "Prince of the dominion of wickedness" is Belial. Michael's exaltation (13:12-14) is the eschatological climax. Construct chains hyphenated throughout.*
